Now I understand the COD marker structure. The COD marker contains:
1. `Scod` (1 byte) - coding style
2. `SGcod (A)` (1 byte) - progression order
3. `SGcod (B)` (2 bytes) - number of layers
4. `SGcod (C)` (1 byte) - MCT
5. `SPcod (D)` (1 byte) - numresolutions - 1
6. `SPcod (E)` (1 byte) - cblkw - 2
7. `SPcod (F)` (1 byte) - cblkh - 2
8. `SPcod (G)` (1 byte) - cblksty (this is where HT style is set, bit 0x40)
9. `SPcod (H)` (1 byte) - qmfbid
10. `SPcod (I)` (1 byte) - precint size (if PRT is set)
